info.title: ORYN API
info.description: Self-hosted AI quality engineering platform. AI reasons. Rust executes. Evidence proves. Humans govern.

get.summary:
Download artifact bytes. Images, video, JSON and text are served inline;
anything else (e.g. trace zips) as an attachment. Always sandboxed.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Relative path to return to after sign-in.

get.summary: Scenario-by-scenario comparison of two executions of the same project.

Server-sent events: `job` events as they are recorded (claimed, started,
finished, retried, cancelled) and a final `end` event with the execution status.
Step results are not streamed; read them from the job once it has finished.
Full-text search over the analysed repository content (secrets redacted at index time).

post.summary:
Queue an execution. Only approved, executable scenarios run (draft ones too when
the workspace does not require approval). Returns immediately; follow progress
with the events stream.
Compile Gherkin against the step library without saving.

Generate a test plan (status `draft`). With AI, the model sees requirements,
detected routes and redacted repository snippets, all fenced as untrusted data,
and must answer in the plan JSON schema; every scenario is compiled against the
step library before it is shown.

Approve a plan: every `accepted` item (or every non-rejected item when none are
marked accepted) that compiles becomes its own suite with approved scenarios,
linked to the item's requirement keys. Requires `test:approve`.
Recompute deterministic recommendations from coverage, flakiness, failures and routes.

Stop recording; events are converted to library steps. Typed passwords arrive
redacted from the runner and are replaced by a `{{password}}` variable.
Rank runnable scenarios by their relationship to the changed files (rules in docs/METRICS.md).

Upload a ZIP archive (request body is the raw archive). Validated before extraction:
no path traversal, absolute paths or symlinks; size and compression-ratio limits.

Re-run analysis. Git sources are re-cloned to pick up new commits; the change set
compares file hashes with the previous run.

Approve, return to draft, or archive scenarios. Approval requires `test:approve`
and only executable scenarios (every step compiled) can be approved.

put.summary:
Save edited Gherkin. Scenarios are matched by name: unchanged names keep their
history and approval; edited steps return an approved scenario to draft.

get.summary: Requirement → scenario → latest result matrix, with coverage figures (see docs/METRICS.md).
The role → permission matrix enforced by the server.
The closed library of supported Gherkin step phrasings.

post.summary: Lease the next queued job (204 when none).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: screenshot, video, trace, log, console, network, response

post.summary:
Report a finished job. The verdict comes from the worker's deterministic engine;
retries are decided here from the execution's retry policy.
Renew the job lease. `cancel_requested: true` tells the worker to stop the job.
Self-registration of a shared worker with the instance bootstrap token.
Send a tiny structured request to verify the key, model and JSON output support.
Check the stored token against the provider's "current user" endpoint.
Register a worker for this workspace and return its token.

delete.summary: Revoke a worker: its token stops working immediately and its leased jobs are requeued.

get.summary: Readiness: dependencies reachable. 503 when the database is down.

path.description: For `local`: a directory under the server's ORYN_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT.

url.description: Full https clone URL (for `git`, or instead of `repo`).

ArtifactRef.description: Artifact produced by a job, uploaded separately; the result references it by name.

needs_setup.description: True until the first account exists; the first account becomes the instance admin.

kinds.description: Job kinds this worker can run now: `api`, `browser`, `mixed`.

secrets.description: Decrypted environment secrets for this job only. Never logged; redacted from evidence.

retried_job.description: Set when the job will be retried as a new attempt.

base_url.description: Web base URL. Defaults to https://github.com or https://gitlab.com.

token.description: Personal access token with read access to repositories. Encrypted at rest.

project_id.description: Limit to one project; all projects when omitted.

secret.description:
Webhook: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret (sent as `x-oryn-signature: sha256=…`).
Slack: the incoming-webhook URL. Encrypted at rest.

instructions.description: What to focus on, in your words. Treated as data by the model.

requirement_ids.description: Requirements to plan for; all requirements when empty.

color.description: Identity tint: one of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

base_url.description: Required for azure_openai (resource endpoint) and openai_compatible; optional otherwise.

models.description: Models with prices. Anthropic and Mock get sensible defaults when empty.

role.description: Role ceiling; capped by your own workspace role at use time.

secret.description: Shown once. Store it now; only its hash is kept.

Environment.description: Environment as returned by the API: secret *names* only.

allowed_hosts.description: Extra hosts steps may reach (base URL hosts are always allowed). `*.example.com` wildcards allowed.

secrets.description:
Secrets: a string sets the value, `null` keeps the stored value, omitting a name deletes it.
Values are encrypted at rest and never returned.

variables.description: Plain variables, available as `{{name}}` in steps.

flips.description: Number of pass↔fail transitions across consecutive final runs.

passed_on_retry.description: Executions where an attempt failed and a retry then passed.

content.description:
Markdown or plain text. Markdown: each `##` heading (or `#` when there are no `##`)
becomes a requirement; a leading `KEY-n` in the heading becomes its key.

source.description: Name of the source document, recorded on each requirement.

use_ai.description: Ask the configured model for an interpretation (labelled, stored separately).

attempts.description: Earlier attempts of this scenario in the same execution.

JobResult.description: What a worker reports when a job finishes.

error.description: Infrastructure error (adapter unreachable, timeout) as opposed to an assertion failure.

JobStatus.description: Lifecycle of a single job (one scenario attempt) on the execution fabric.

avg_execution_ms.description: Mean duration of finished executions in the window (ms).

jobs_passed.description: Final-attempt job outcomes in the window.

pass_rate.description: passed / (passed + failed + errored); null when the denominator is 0.

workspace_name.description: Name of the first workspace; defaults to "<name>'s workspace".

changed_files.description:
Changed file paths (e.g. from `git diff --name-only`). Empty = the change set
from the last repository analysis.

min_score.description: Minimum score to include (smoke baseline scores 0.5).

covered.description: Requirements linked to ≥1 approved, executable scenario.

failing.description: Covered requirements with at least one linked scenario whose latest run failed.

verified.description: Covered requirements whose linked scenarios' latest final runs all passed.

key.description: Optional stable key (e.g. US-8). Defaults to the next REQ-n.

failed_only.description: Only scenarios whose final result was failed or error.

Role.description: Workspace role. Ordered from most to least privileged.

environment_id.description: Defaults to the project's default environment.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts per scenario (1 = no retry). Errors and timeouts are retried; failures only with `retry_on_failure`.

suite_id.description: Run every runnable scenario of this suite.

tags.description: Or scenarios carrying any of these tags (e.g. `@smoke`).

last_status.description: Status of the most recent final job for this scenario.

ScenarioRun.description: Scenario history for flaky detection and comparison: final status per run, newest first.

ScenarioStatus.description:
Governance status of a scenario: AI-generated scenarios start as drafts and
must be approved before they can execute (unless the project opts out).

body.description: Library steps it expands to, one per line (validated).

phrase.description: The phrase authors write, e.g. `I sign in as the demo customer`.

StepResult.description: Result of one step, produced by the worker's engine.

artifact.description: Name of the artifact (screenshot) attached to this step, if any.

message.description: Human-readable reason for failure, produced by deterministic evaluation.

observation.description: Raw observation (e.g. adapter observation or HTTP response summary).

gherkin.description: Gherkin generated from the recorded events (redacted; library steps only).

path.description: Repository path the feature came from, if any.

api_key.description: A new key replaces the stored one.

require_approval.description: When true, only approved scenarios can run.

token.description: Shown once. Start the worker with `ORYN_WORKER_TOKEN=<token>`.

tags.name: worker-protocol
tags.description: Used by remote workers; authenticated with a worker token
